title: scabiosa succisa var. glabra
intro: Scabiosa succisa var. glabra, commonly known as Field Scabious, is a perennial herbaceous plant in the borage family (Boraginaceae). It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include relief from respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its expectorant properties. The health benefits of Field Scabious are attributed to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antitussive properties, which are thought to be mediated by its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. These constituents are believed to contribute to the plant's ability to calm respiratory irritation and reduce inflammation.
